jobs.title: Mechaniker (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Mechaniker (w/m/d) — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Biel/Bienne (BE).

Mechaniker (w/m/d)
Pensum: 80-100%
Arbeitsort: Biel
Anstellungsart: Unbefristet
## Ihre Aufgaben
- - Aufbauen von Baugruppen und Maschinen nach Zeichnungen und Stücklisten
- - Termingerechte Abwicklung der verlangten Produktionsmengen unter Berücksichtigung der Qualitätsrichtlinien und
- Einhaltung der Vorgabezeiten
- - Unterhalt der Anlagen und Eirichtungen
## Ihr Profil
- - Abgeschlossene Grundausbildung zum Polymechaniker EFZ oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
- - Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Maschinen- oder Anlagebau oder in der Baugruppenmontage
- - Grundwissen in Hydraulik und Pneumatik
- - Kenntnisse der Steuerung Heidenhain sind wünschenswert
- - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
- MIKRON MILL ist einer der weltweiten Experten für vertikales Fräsen und Erfinder des Hochgeschwindigkeitsfräsens. Die
- automatisierungsfähigen Maschinen sind bekannt für dynamische Präzision und Freiformgenauigkeit und liefern
- Spitzenleistungen bei komplexen Anwendungen. MIKRON MILL steht für Innovation, Agilität und nachhaltigen Mehrwert.
## Wir bieten
- Ausgezeichnete Karrierechancen: UNITED MACHINING bietet viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung. Wir bieten einen
- Talentmanagementprozess (MyNextBigStep), um Ihre Karriere zu fördern.
- Ausgezeichnete Schulungsinstrumente: Bei UNITED MACHINING bieten wir Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für alle. Wir bieten
- globale Lerntools sowie Schulungen und spezialisierte Kurse.
- Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit und Innovation: Wir haben hohe Nachhaltigkeits- und Innovationsziele. Lassen Sie uns
- gemeinsam auf eine nachhaltige Zukunft hinarbeiten.
- Über uns
- UNITED MACHINING ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Komplettlösungen für Hersteller von
- Präzisionskomponenten und Werkzeugen sowie für den Formenbau. Das Portfolio umfasst Maschinen für das Fräsen, die
- Funkenerosion, die Laserstrukturierung, die Lasermikrobearbeitung und die additive Fertigung. Darüber hinaus bietet der
- Geschäftsbereich Spindeln, Automatisierungslösungen, Werkzeuge und digitalisierte Lösungen, die durch einen
- unübertroffenen Kundenservice und Support unterstützt werden.
- Zu UNITED MACHINING gehören die Marken AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC und SYSTEM 3R.
- UNITED MACHINING hat seinen Hauptsitz in Biel, Schweiz, und beschäftigt derzeit über 3'000 Mitarbeitende an mehr als
- 50 Standorten weltweit.
## Ihre Kontaktperson
Christine Steiner
HR Business Partner
+41 32 366 11 11
Web
United Machining Mill AG
Roger-Federer-Allee 7
2504 Biel
Schweiz

improvement.

Application Engineer – Advanced Technical Support
Workload: 100%
Location: Losone
Job type: Unlimited
Your tasks
Provide advanced application support for EDM technologies, including test cuts, customer support, technical training
and demo applications.
Analyze, reproduce and resolve complex application issues, defining effective action plans for technical interventions
when required.
Perform on-site customer support and field interventions worldwide, including international travel when needed.
Support technical evaluations, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, demonstrations and benchmarking
activities.
Collaborate with Product Management, R&D and internal experts to contribute to product, process and technology
improvements.
Your profile
Technical education in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic Engineering or a related field. Candidates with a technical
diploma and solid relevant experience are equally encouraged to apply.
Good understanding of EDM processes, with hands-on experience in Wire EDM and/or Die Sinking EDM considered a strong
advantage.
Several years of experience with CNC machines, ideally including CAD/CAM programming.
Willingness to travel internationally for on-site customer support activities
Fluent Italian and good English skills, ideally B2 level or higher; German is a plus.
AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation leader
in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the production
of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer - Electronics Production 100%
jobs.description:
Quality Engineer - Electronics Production 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Losone (TI).

Quality Engineer -- Electronics Production Your tasks
* Ensure quality control of PCBA production processes (THT, wave soldering, selective soldering, mixed technology) and
maintain control plans and acceptance criteria. * Support production teams in troubleshooting electronic failures and
lead structured problem-solving activities (8D, 5 Why, root cause analysis). * Ensure reliability of electronic test
systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, functional test benches) and implement corrective actions on test failures. * Drive
continuous improvement initiatives to reduce internal defects and support New Product Introduction (NPI) with robust
manufacturing and test processes. * Support supplier quality activities, define incoming inspection requirements, and
contribute to the analysis of assemblies returned from the field.
Your profile
* Degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical background; 3--5 years of experience in
electronics manufacturing, quality, or test engineering. * Knowledge of PCB assembly technologies, soldering processes,
and solder joint quality; experience with electronic test systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, ICT or similar) is a strong
advantage. * Structured problem-solving mindset (8D, 5 Why) with hands-on, pragmatic approach and strong technical
curiosity. * Ability to work cross-functionally with production, R\&D, and supplier teams; clear and effective
communication with technical stakeholders. * Fluent in Italian; English B2 or higher required.
About us AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation
leader in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the
production of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance. UNITED MACHINING is one of
the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools manufacturers and the
mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining, and additive
manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized solutions
backed by unrivaled customer services and support. UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES,
MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has
over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites worldwide. Your contact Giulia Mollar HR Business Partner +41 91 806 90 30
giulia.mollar@georgfischer.com Location Agie Charmilles SA Via Zandone 1 6616 Losone Switzerland

• Your tasks * Ensure quality control of PCBA production processes (THT, wave soldering, selective soldering, mixed technology) and maintain control plans and acceptance criteria. * Support production teams in troubleshooting electronic failures and lead structured problem-solving activities (8D, 5 Why, root cause analysis). * Ensure reliability of electronic test systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, functional test benches) and implement corrective actions on test failures. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce internal defects and support New Product Introduction (NPI) with robust manufacturing and test processes. * Support supplier quality activities, define incoming inspection requirements, and contribute to the analysis of assemblies returned from the field.
• Your profile * Degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical background; 3--5 years of experience in electronics manufacturing, quality, or test engineering. * Knowledge of PCB assembly technologies, soldering processes, and solder joint quality; experience with electronic test systems (SPEA, Flying Probe, ICT or similar) is a strong advantage. * Structured problem-solving mindset (8D, 5 Why) with hands-on, pragmatic approach and strong technical curiosity. * Ability to work cross-functionally with production, R\&D, and supplier teams; clear and effective communication with technical stakeholders. * Fluent in Italian; English B2 or higher required. About us AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation leader in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the production of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance. UNITED MACHINING is one of the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools manufacturers and the mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining, and additive manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized solutions backed by unrivaled customer services and support. UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites worldwide. Your contact Giulia Mollar HR Business Partner +41 91 806 90 30 giulia.mollar@georgfischer.com Location Agie Charmilles SA Via Zandone 1 6616 Losone Switzerland Indietro

Diagnosetechniker (w/m/d) 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Biel/Bienne (BE).

Diagnosetechniker (w/m/d) Ihre Aufgaben
* Sie sind die zentrale technische Ansprechperson für unsere Verkaufsgesellschaften und unterstützen diese im Second
Level Support bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen. * Sie nehmen Beanstandungen unserer Servicetechniker entgegen,
bereiten diese strukturiert auf und koordinieren die Servicefälle über Telefon, E-Mail und das Ticketing-System. * Sie
erarbeiten nachhaltige technische Lösungen, kommunizieren diese lösungsorientiert an den First Level Support und
stellen eine hohe Servicequalität sicher. * Sie sammeln, analysieren und bewerten wiederkehrende Problemfälle,
identifizieren systematische Fehler und treiben aktiv die kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung voran. * Sie agieren
als Schnittstelle zum Third Level Support (Hersteller), betreuen Windows-basierte Maschinensteuerungen und erstellen
Servicedokumentationen sowie Unterlagen für Koordinationsmeetings.
## Ihr Profil
- * Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung und verbinden technisches Verständnis mit einer
- ausgeprägten Affinität zu kaufmännischen und organisatorischen Themen. * Sie bringen mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in
- einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit, idealerweise im industriellen oder technischen Umfeld. * Begriffe wie Fräsen,
- Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und PLC-Programmierung sind für Sie Teil Ihres beruflichen Alltags und wecken Ihr
- technisches Interesse. * Sie arbeiten sicher mit Windows-basierten Systemen und bringen solide Informatikkenntnisse für
- den Umgang mit Maschinensteuerungen und Ticketing-Tools mit. * Sie kommunizieren klar und lösungsorientiert und
- verfügen über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Kenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
- Über uns MIKRON MILL ist einer der weltweiten Experten für vertikales Fräsen und Erfinder des
- Hochgeschwindigkeitsfräsens. Die automatisierungsfähigen Maschinen sind bekannt für dynamische Präzision und
- Freiformgenauigkeit und liefern Spitzenleistungen bei komplexen Anwendungen. MIKRON MILL steht für Innovation, Agilität
- und nachhaltigen Mehrwert. UNITED MACHINING ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Komplettlösungen für
- Hersteller von Präzisionskomponenten und Werkzeugen sowie für den Formenbau. Das Portfolio umfasst Maschinen für das
- Fräsen, die Funkenerosion, die Laserstrukturierung, die Lasermikrobearbeitung und die additive Fertigung. Darüber
- hinaus bietet der Geschäftsbereich Spindeln, Automatisierungslösungen, Werkzeuge und digitalisierte Lösungen, die durch
- einen unübertroffenen Kundenservice und Support unterstützt werden. Zu UNITED MACHINING gehören die Marken AGIE
- CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES, MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC und SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING hat seinen Hauptsitz in Biel,
- Schweiz, und beschäftigt derzeit über 3'000 Mitarbeitende an mehr als 50 Standorten weltweit. Ihre Kontaktperson
- Christine Steiner Personnel Specialst +41 32 366 11 11 Arbeitsort United Machining Mill AG Roger-Federer-Allee 7 2504

Service Engineer Laser Your tasks
* Installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of laser texturing and cutting machines * Execution of

jobs.title: Project Leader 100%
jobs.description:
Project Leader 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Losone (TI).

Project Leader Your tasks
* Manage new product development projects end-to-end, ensuring compliance with specifications, budget, and deadlines;
report progress and deviations to management. * Coordinate and assess internal and external development partners,
focusing on expertise, efficiency, and quality. * Lead core team meetings, reviews, and workshops; maintain full
project documentation throughout the lifecycle. * Actively participate in requirement engineering in close cooperation
with product management, in line with global standards and guidelines. * Drive stakeholder management, cross-project
cooperation, and continuous improvement of local processes and procedures.
Your profile
* University degree in Management, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical background with
relevant further education. * 2--4 years of experience project management in a multidisciplinary industrial
environment. * Solid knowledge of project management methods and tools (WBS, scheduling, risk management, DFMEA/PFMEA)
and MS Project, MS Office, and SAP. * Structured and independent working style, strong communication skills, and
confidence in presenting to diverse audiences. * Fluent in Italian. English level B2 or higher.
About us AGIE CHARMILLES, inventor of EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), is known as a premium brand and innovation
leader in wire, die-sinking, and hole-drilling EDM. Its automation-ready solutions are used in mold making and the
production of high-end components, offering Swiss precision, reliability, and performance. UNITED MACHINING is one of
the world's leading providers of complete solutions for precision components and tools manufacturers and the
mold-making industry. The portfolio includes milling, EDM, laser texturing, laser micromachining, and additive
manufacturing machines. Additionally, the division offers spindles, automation, tooling, and digitalized solutions
backed by unrivaled customer services and support. UNITED MACHINING includes the brands AGIE CHARMILLES, CHARMILLES,
MIKRON MILL, LIECHTI, STEP TEC and SYSTEM 3R. UNITED MACHINING is headquartered in Biel, Switzerland, and currently has
over 3'000 employees on over 50 sites worldwide. Your contact Giulia Mollar HR Business Partner +41 91 806 90 30
giulia.mollar@georgfischer.com Location Agie Charmilles SA Via Zandone 1 6616 Losone Switzerland

Leader del progetto 100% — AGIE Charmilles SA (GF Machining Solutions), Biel/Bienne (TI). Leader del progetto 100% AGIE Charmilles SA AGIE Charmilles SA, CH-6616 Losone None Angestellte (Schweiz) Nessuno Angestellte (globale) Temporaneo: No. Carico di lavoro: 100% CH-6616 Losone Lingua: Inserzione originale / Candidarsi Homepage Leader del progetto
• I tuoi compiti * Gestire nuovi progetti di sviluppo del prodotto end-to-end, garantendo il rispetto delle specifiche, budget e scadenze; riferire i progressi e le deviazioni alla gestione. * Coordinare e valutare i partner di sviluppo interno ed esterno, concentrandosi su competenze, efficienza e qualità. * Lead core team incontri, recensioni e workshop; mantenere pieno documentazione del progetto in tutto il ciclo di vita. * Partecipa attivamente all'ingegneria dei requisiti in stretta collaborazione con la gestione dei prodotti, in linea con gli standard e le linee guida globali. * Guidare la gestione delle parti interessate, cross-project cooperazione e miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle procedure locali. Il tuo profilo * Laurea in Management, ingegneria meccanica o elettrica, o background tecnico equivalente con pertinente ulteriore istruzione. * 2--4 anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto in un industriale multidisciplinare ambiente. * Conoscenza solida dei metodi e degli strumenti di gestione del progetto (WBS, pianificazione, gestione del rischio, DFMEA/PFMEA) e MS Project, MS Office e SAP. * Stile di lavoro strutturato e indipendente, forti capacità di comunicazione, e fiducia nel presentare a un pubblico diverso. * Fluente in italiano. Livello inglese B2 o superiore. AGIE CHARMILLES, inventore di EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), è conosciuto come marchio premium e innovazione leader in filo, die-sinking, e foro-drilling EDM. Le sue soluzioni di automazione sono utilizzate nella produzione di stampi e produzione di componenti di fascia alta, offrendo precisione, affidabilità e prestazioni svizzere. UNITED MACHINING è uno di fornitori leader a livello mondiale di soluzioni complete per i produttori di componenti e utensili di precisione e industria dello stampaggio.
